symptomDescriptions.db_pool_exhaustion: Postgres connection pool or row-lock saturation
symptomDescriptions.webhook_timeout: outbound/downstream webhook delivery 5xx, timeout, retry backoff, or DLQ
symptomDescriptions.auth_failure: inbound HMAC/signature verification mismatch, secret rotation, or clock skew
symptomDescriptions.vlan_packet_loss: switch VLAN CRC errors or uplink packet loss
symptomDescriptions.tls_cert_expiry: expired X.509/TLS certificate or handshake outage
symptomDescriptions.redis_eviction_spike: Redis maxmemory saturation, key evictions, or hit ratio drop
symptomDescriptions.dns_resolution_failure: CoreDNS upstream SERVFAIL or lookup timeout
symptomDescriptions.lambda_oom_throttle: AWS Lambda OutOfMemory or 429 concurrency throttle

db_pool_exhaustion.title: Database Connection Pool Saturation
checks: Verify active vs. idle connections against Postgres max_connections
Inspect long-running row-lock transactions holding connection slots

webhook_timeout.title: Downstream Webhook Delivery Timeout
checks: Confirm idempotency key deduplication on retried deliveries
Check dead-letter queue depth before increasing retry backoff

auth_failure.title: HMAC Signature Verification Mismatch
checks: Confirm clock skew is within AGENTGATE_WEBHOOK_MAX_AGE_SECONDS
Verify overlapping secret rotation window between caller and ingress

vlan_packet_loss.title: Edge Switch / VLAN Latency & Packet Drop
checks: Inspect interface error counters and duplex negotiation on uplink ports
Verify VLAN trunk tagging and QoS shaping policies

tls_cert_expiry.title: Ingress TLS Certificate Expiration
checks: Inspect presented X.509 leaf and intermediate chain expiration timestamps
Trigger ACME / ACM certificate renewal and reload ingress TLS listeners

redis_eviction_spike.title: Redis Memory Saturation & Key Eviction Spike
checks: Inspect maxmemory-policy and top key-prefix memory footprint
Verify TTL distribution and scale cache shard capacity before OOM

dns_resolution_failure.title: CoreDNS Upstream SERVFAIL & Timeout
checks: Check CoreDNS upstream forwarder reachability and UDP/TCP socket saturation
Validate cluster resolv.conf ndots settings and DNS cache hit rate

lambda_oom_throttle.title: AWS Lambda Memory Exhaustion & Concurrency Throttle
checks: Inspect Lambda MemorySize vs. MaxMemoryUsed in CloudWatch REPORT logs
Check reserved concurrency headroom and upstream 429 retry policy

toolDescriptions.inspect_log_excerpt: Read bounded diagnostic log lines for a service (untrusted external telemetry; read-only).
toolDescriptions.check_latency_budget: Compare observed service p95 latency in milliseconds against its SLA budget and return the SLA-calibrated recommendedSeverity (low, medium, high, or critical).
toolDescriptions.lookup_runbook: Fetch the verified runbookId and remediation checklist for one of the 8 symptom categories.

inspect_log_excerpt.service: Lowercase service identifier (e.g. checkout-api, webhook-ingress, auth-gateway).
inspect_log_excerpt.maxLines: Maximum number of bounded log lines to return (1-50).

check_latency_budget.service: Lowercase service identifier to look up SLA p95 latency budget.
check_latency_budget.p95Ms: Observed p95 latency in milliseconds from the alert.
